items.quote: Please tell us in writing by 16 December 2026 whether you would like to extend.
items.computation: The letter gives an explicit calendar date by which the written reply must be given: 16 December 2026. This is a date set by private contractual agreement, not a statutory period subject to section 187-193 BGB counting rules, so the date is taken as printed. 16 December 2026 is a Wednesday, not a weekend day or NW public holiday, so no shift is required.
